newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle up $1 in light test - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle up $1 in light test - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers were $1.00 per cwt higher in a light test, compared with Monday's close, USDA said.
